method: Owned native Tern window with isolated plugin installation, daemon, HOME, shell and credential-free OMP. Captured the actual OMP dock, then replayed it through TSP with synthetic reset-credit usage spans matching the installed OMP renderer. No model turn or account request.
commands: tern plugin dir --json (isolated TERN_CONFIG_DIR and TERN_DAEMON_SOCKET)
tern plugin reload usage-preview (same isolated environment)
assertions: Reset-credit span and separator hidden before hover; credit visible during hover and hidden on leave.
Quota span text and geometry unchanged by hover.
Git counts, model control, send control and usage hit-target geometry unchanged by hover.
Popup lies above the usage strip.
No-credit usage has no popup; credit-only usage retains an icon hover target.
evidence: Disposable native control log, geometry, and screenshot paths recorded in /tmp/usage-acceptance-evidence.json; not committed.
